title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to display/add “Sent To” on the Sent Emails (8883, List) page?
summary: The Sent Emails page in Business Central does not display recipient information by default. This post explains how to add a 'Sent To' field using a page extension that retrieves recipients from the Email Message codeunit by accessing the temporary Sent Email table.
key_points: The Sent Emails page (8883) uses a temporary table and does not include the 'Sent To' field
Table 8889 'Sent Email' has internal access restrictions, but codeunit 8904 'Email Message' provides public methods to retrieve recipients
A page extension can add a new field that populates recipient data via the GetRecipients method on OnAfterGetRecord trigger
The solution uses RecordRef and FieldRef to access the MessageId from the temporary table and match it with the email message
